radar.instrument: Texture statistics of the slope grid (terrain-roughness proxy, not radar)

mineral.instrument: Sentinel-2 L2A S2A_19KFT_20230217_0_L2A, cloud-masked land pixels (91% of the window clear, 0% open water)

thermal.instrument: NASA POWER climatology (MERRA-2 2 m air temperature)

curve.instrument: Sine-based day-night model between the low and high
